description: This file defines the ComponentElement class in Drupal, responsible for rendering component elements with support for slots, variants, and attributes. It includes methods for pre-render processing, template generation, and attribute merging.

classes.name: ComponentElement
classes.description: A render element class for handling Drupal components with slots and attributes.

methods.name: preRenderComponent
methods.description: Expands a component into an inline template with an attachment, processing props and slots.

methods.name: generateComponentTemplate
methods.description: Generates a Twig template string for rendering the component with slots.

methods.name: mergeElementAttributesToPropAttributes
methods.description: Merges element attributes into the component's props attributes, ensuring proper rendering.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides metadata about the render element, including pre-render callbacks and default properties.
